checks.must: The ingest handler URL-decodes the S3 event object key (urllib.parse.unquote_plus or equivalent) before using it. S3 event notifications deliver keys URL-encoded with '+' for spaces, so names like 'Season 2/Episode 01 – Pilot.mov' break without it.

The 2-hour delay before transcoding is kept with a mechanism that supports it: EventBridge Scheduler one-time schedule, Step Functions Wait, or similar. SQS DelaySeconds (max 900 s = 15 min) used for the 2-hour hold fails, unless it is explicitly re-queued in a loop that reaches 2 hours.

Replacing a file during the hold still results in only the latest version being transcoded: the generation check is ported to S3 (versionId, ETag, or LastModified compared with the job), or the replaced job is cancelled. Dropping the check fails.
The AWS trigger still fires when an existing key is overwritten (s3:ObjectCreated:* / EventBridge Object Created), not only on first upload.

The 30-minute transcode (timeout 1800 s, dispatch_deadline 1800 s) is not put on Lambda unchanged (15-minute max): it runs on ECS/Fargate, Batch, MediaConvert, or Step Functions, or the 15-minute limit is explicitly flagged.
The Cloud Tasks rate limits are carried over: at most 3 concurrent transcodes (e.g. Lambda/SQS maximum_concurrency = 3, Step Functions/ECS concurrency limit), or the change is explicitly flagged.

The retry behaviour is kept or flagged: transcode retried up to 4 attempts with backoff; ingest not retried (RETRY_POLICY_DO_NOT_RETRY), whereas S3->Lambda async invocation retries twice by default unless MaximumRetryAttempts = 0.

The 12 Pub/Sub message attributes are handled for the 10-attribute limit of SNS/SQS message attributes: moved into the message body/JSON, reduced, or the limit explicitly flagged. Publishing 12 MessageAttributes unchanged fails.
The Athena SQL keeps Sunday-start weeks. Trino date_trunc('week', ...) starts on Monday, so it must be shifted (e.g. date_add('day', -(day_of_week(d) % 7), d)) or the difference explicitly flagged.
The weekend count is correct in Athena: BigQuery DAYOFWEEK 1=Sunday,7=Saturday; Trino day_of_week is 1=Monday..7=Sunday, so weekend is (6, 7). Copying IN (1, 7) unchanged fails.
SAFE_DIVIDE is translated without integer truncation or division-by-zero errors (e.g. CAST(... AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) or try()).
No unrequested behaviour changes without calling them out (e.g. message retention 7 days, memory 4 GiB, IAM scope).
